nodes.display_name: A medical assistant for diagnostic tests
nodes.long_description:
Repetition of the task of preparing diagnostic tools on the shelves in virtual reality 
to improve the ability of medical assistants to perform diagnostic tests for people with developmental disabilities. Diagnostic testing medical assistant content
nodes.short_description:
1.press ready to work, put on gown, mask and gloves
2.Lay down white paper and pour out tips
3.Close the tip cap and insert into the holder 
4.Tap Clean up and discard paper and mask gloves in the medical waste bin
